items.prompt: To jest ___ siostra. (This is my sister.)
items.explanation: Mój agrees with the noun: siostra is feminine, so moja.
optionNotes: Moje is for neuter nouns and the plural.
Mojego is the accusative for male people.

items.explanation: Jej (her) depends on the owner, Ola, and never changes.
optionNotes: There is no verb here, so brat stays in the nominative.

items.explanation: Znać takes the accusative. A male person: mojego brata.
optionNotes: The nominative: the object must change.
Moja is feminine; brat is masculine.
The noun must change too: brata.

items.prompt: You ask a woman you don't know: "Excuse me, is this your bag?"
items.explanation: Formal "your" for a woman is pani, and it never changes.
optionNotes: Twoja is for friends and family.
After to the noun stays in the nominative: torba.
Panią is the accusative of pani, not "your".
